title: Listen and Choose a Response — Apartment Life

questions.stem: Didn't you pay the electric bill last week?

options.A: The electric car is very quiet.
options.B: Yes, and I'll pay it next week.
options.C: It was about forty dollars last week.
options.D: I meant to, but the website wasn't working.

questions.explanation: This explains why the bill wasn't paid. 'Yes' with a future plan contradicts itself, and the others reuse 'electric' or 'last week'.
questions.speaker: f4

audioSegments.text: Didn't you pay the electric bill last week?
